title: Show HN: I made tool that let's you see everything about any website
guide_zh: Web Check 将网站元信息与安全数据查询集中到开源工具。
author: lissy93
excerpt: Yes, it's open source: https://github.com/lissy93/web-check :) Why I'm building this? There are a lot of tools out there for discovering meta and security data relating to a website, IP or server. But currently, there isn't anything that does everything, all in one place and without a paywall/ user sign up. It's still a WIP, and I'm working on a new version, with some more comprehensive checks, so any feedback would be much appreciated :)
